name: consulting-delivery
title: Consulting delivery
summary: Discover, synthesise, design, (optionally) build and hand over; fits advisory asks, assessments and recommendations.

stages.name: discover
stages.goal: Gather sourced evidence on the problem and context.
stages.exit: The user confirms the evidence covers the question.
stages.skip_when: The user supplies the evidence base.

stages.name: synthesis
stages.goal: Turn evidence into findings and an options matrix.
stages.exit: The user agrees the findings and options.
stages.skip_when: The design stage already covers the synthesis (practitioner call).

stages.name: design
stages.goal: Shape the recommended solution and its trade-offs.
stages.exit: The user picks the recommended option.

stages.name: build
stages.goal: Build a working proof of the recommendation.
stages.exit: The user clicks through the proof.
stages.skip_when: The client asked for a report only.

stages.name: handover
stages.goal: Write the deliverable and the walkthrough.
